info.name: TempGuru Event Staffing API
info.description:
Read-only REST API for W-2 event staffing data across 300+ US and Canadian markets. No authentication required. All rates are all-inclusive W-2 bill rates (worker pay, payroll taxes, workers' comp, general liability, coordinator support).

MCP server: https://mcp.tempguru.co/mcp
OpenAPI 3.1: https://mcp.tempguru.co/openapi.json
Website: https://tempguru.co

item.name: Discovery
item.description: List the cities and staffing roles TempGuru covers.

query.description: Filter by 2-letter state code or full name (US + Canadian provinces)

request.description:
Returns all cities TempGuru staffs with tier classification. Optional filters: state (postal code or name), tier (hub/mid/small).

hub = 25 major metros (NYC, LA, Boston, Chicago, SF, etc.)
mid = 129 secondary markets
small = 191 tertiary markets

Returns all event staffing roles TempGuru places: brand ambassadors, registration, hospitality, setup/breakdown, ushers, gate staff, crowd control, guest services, booth monitors, team leads.

The returned `slug` values are the keys used in the pricing and availability endpoints.

item.name: Planning
item.description: Availability lead-time guidance and hourly rate ranges for specific markets.

query.description: Optional: role slug or name — adds rate range to response

request.description:
Returns lead-time guidance for a city + date pair. Recommendation values:
- yes: comfortable window, proceed normally
- tight: at or near typical lead time, move quickly
- rush: inside typical lead time, escalation likely needed
- very-rush: < 24 hours

This is planning guidance, NOT a real-time inventory reservation. Confirmed bookings go through tempguru.co/get-staffing.

response.name: Boston, comfortable lead time
response.body:
{
  "input": { "city": "Boston", "date": "2026-09-15" },
  "city_found": true,
  "city": "Boston",
  "state": "Massachusetts",
  "city_tier": "hub",
  "event_date": "2026-09-15",
  "days_until_event": 102,
  "typical_lead_time_hours": 72,
  "recommendation": "yes",
  "role": null,
  "count": null,
  "notes": ["Hub market — strong network depth, typically 48–72h lead time."]
}

response.name: Boston + Brand Ambassadors + headcount

query.description: Role slug or display name (e.g. 'Brand Ambassadors')

request.description:
Returns the all-inclusive hourly rate range (low–high) for a specific role in a specific city.

All rates are W-2 bill rates: worker pay, employer-side payroll taxes (FICA/FUTA/SUTA), workers' comp, general liability, and coordinator support — no hidden fees at invoice time.

Brand Ambassadors floor at $40/hr in every market.

response.name: Brand Ambassadors in Boston
response.body:
{

  "state": "Massachusetts",

item.name: Compliance
item.description: State-level employment compliance summaries for event staffing decisions.

query.description: Two-letter state code or full name. All 50 states + DC.

request.description:
Returns minimum wage, overtime thresholds (weekly and daily where applicable), and state-specific quirks relevant to event staffing — CA meal-break rules, NY spread-of-hours, etc.

Informational only — not legal advice. Consult employment counsel for binding interpretation.

response.name: California
response.body:
{
  "state": "California",
  "state_abbr": "CA",
  "min_wage_usd": 16.50,

  "overtime_threshold_weekly_hours": 40,

  "unique_rules": [
    "Daily overtime after 8 hours at 1.5x; after 12 hours at 2x",
    "30-minute unpaid meal break required before 5th hour of shift",
    "10-minute paid rest break per 4 hours worked"
  ],
  "liability_coverage_included": true,
  "workers_comp_included": true
}
